snippet.title: Flaghead | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Flaghead is an arena shooter roguelite where you play as a country, surviving through history from the dark ages into the cybernetic futures and beyond.

Don't forget to Wishlist Flaghead on Steam to be notified on release.
